My name is Tseu Heng Loong, alias Tseu Ma Bi,
age 47, native of Komro, m/unemployed, residing in a hut

Before the outbreak of the local hostilities,
I was a fish hawker at Zikawei and through that business
I was able to maintain the living of my family, which con-
sisted of my wife and two children. In October, 1937, I
was enlisted as a coolie to transport ammunition by the
4th Regiment, 52nd Brigade, 88 Division, which was fighting
in the Shanghai Area. I worked in this capacity for a
period of about 2½ month with a pay of $1.00 per day.
Following the withdrawal of the Chinese forces, I went to
Zao Ka Doo where I traded as a vegetable hawker.

In April, 1939, while I was still a vegetable
hawker, I met Zoen Yu Foong (單有風) (1st. accused) at
Zao Ka Doo, with whom I have been acquainted for about
six years. Zoen was formerly a worker in a certain cotton
mill, the address of which I do not know. On that occasion
he told me that he was connected with the "China Youth
Anti-Japanese and Traitor Elimination Iron Blood Army" and
advised me to join the organization. He stated that the
object of the Army was to deal with traitors. I agreed and
submitted to him two copies of my photograph. About ten
days later I signed a form and joined the body. However,
Zoen Yu Foong did not tell me the address of the organiza-
tion, but communicated with me by letter addressed to my
hut. I used to meet him in the Dah Chung Hwa Lodging House

i/c of the Ministry of Communications of the
Reformed Government. 7.I.R. 4/8/39 (BW).

The 1st accused further admits that at about
3.40 p.m. 21.2.39, on Sinsa Road near Gordon Road he
concerned together with Soong Vung Foo (not arrested)
and Tau Mau Deu (not arrested) had assassinated Marquis

that Marquis Li Koh Jih usually walked along Sinsa
Road between 3 p.m. and 4 p.m. daily. Several days
prior to the assassination Sung Yeong Kiang and
Sung Vung Foo proceeded to Sinsa Road where the former
pointed out the victim to the latter. On the morning
of the crime, 21.2.39, Sung Yeong Kiang went to the
1st accused's home on Tsapeng Road and instructed
him to meet him at a room, number forgotten, at the

谋杀李国杰侯爵（Marquis Li Koh Jih，李國杰），维新政府交通部主管官员。7.I.R. 1939年8月4日 (BW)。

第一号被告进一步承认，1939年2月21日下午3点40分左右，在新闸路靠近戈登路（Gordon Road）处，他与宋文富（未逮捕）和陶毛头（未逮捕）共同策划并暗杀了维新政府交通部主管官员李国杰侯爵。

第一号被告称，在暗杀前约10天，“抗日除奸铁血军”总指挥张劲庐（Chang Ching Lao，張勁廬）收到情报，称李国杰侯爵通常每天下午3点至4点之间沿新闸路行走。暗杀前几天，沈永江（Sung Yeong Kiang，音译）和宋文富前往新闸路，前者向后者指认了受害者。案发当天早晨，1939年2月21日，沈永江来到第一号被告在乍浦路的家中，指示他在当天下午2点在

Sinza Lodging House, 841 Sinza Road at 2 p.m. that
day. The 1st accused kept the appointment and on
arrival found that Sung Voong Kiang, Soong Vung Foo
and Dau Mau Deu were present in the room. Sung Voong
Kiang gave the 1st accused and Dau Mau Deu an automatic
pistol each whilst Soong Vung Foo was given a Mauser
pistol after which they proceeded on foot to the
entrance of Sing Yuen Tsung (新園邨) alleyway, Sinza
Road near Gordon Road where they waited until 3.40
p.m. when the victim together with one or two other
male Chinese came out of the lane 1124 and walked
west along Sinza Road being followed by the 1st
accused and his two accomplices to a point about
30 yards east of Gordon Road when the 1st accused
walked up close behind the victim, drew his pistol and
fired one shot at the back of the victim's head, who
dropped to the ground whereupon the 1st accused then
fired two more shots into his body. After the shooting
the 1st accused and his two unarrested accomplices
walked east along Sinza Road returning to the Sinza
Lodging House where they reported the assassination
to Sung Voong Kiang and returned the pistols to him
after which they separated, going to their respective
homes. The 1st accused is unable to state where the

Murder of Loh Yue Ding (陆雨亭), Captain of
the 7th Division of the Peace and National
Reconstruction Army of the Reformed Government,
F.I.R. 774/40 Louse.

The 1st and 3rd accused admit that they,
concerned together with three others named Zung
Kyung Hsiang (雍金香), (not arrest), Siau Zang Tseng
(萧长珍), (not arrested), and Siau Tuh Pien (萧杜便)
(not arrested), at about 6.10 p.m. 19.2.40 at Room
228, Central Hotel, 545 Canton Road, assassinated
one named Loh Yue Ding. The 1st accused admits that
the 3rd accused informed him that he had received a
report from one Zung Kyung Hsiang, a member of the
Anti-Japanese and Traitors Elimination Iron Blood
Army, stationed at Luiho, to the effect that the
victim Loh Yue Ding was captain of the 7th division
of the Peace and National Reconstruction Army of the
Reformed Government and he was known to frequent a
certain room in the Central Hotel, Canton Road.

维新政府和平建国军第七师师长陆雨亭（Loh Yue Ding）被杀案。
档案号 F.I.R. 774/40 Louse。

第一和第三被告承认，他们与另外三人，即雍金香（Zung Kyung Hsiang）（未逮捕）、萧长珍（Siau Zang Tseng）（未逮捕）和萧杜便（Siau Tuh Pien）（未逮捕）合谋，于1940年2月19日下午6时10分左右，在广东路545号中央饭店228室，刺杀了一名名为陆雨亭的人。第一被告承认，第三被告曾告知他，收到一名驻扎在浏河（Luiho）的“抗日除奸铁血团”成员雍金香的报告，称受害人陆雨亭是维新政府和平建国军第七师师长，且已知其经常出入广东路中央饭店的某个房间。

On receipt of this information, the 1st accused
instructed the 3rd accused to conduct discreet enquiries
as a result of which the above information was found to
be correct. The 3rd accused on the instructions of
the 1st accused proceeded to Liuho and brought two
other members of the organisation and four pistols
to Shanghai. At 10 a.m. 19.2.40 the 3rd accused
reported to the 1st accused that Siau Zang Tseng,
Siau Tuh Piau and Zung Kyung Hsiang had arrived in
Shanghai and were staying at the home of the latter's
friend in Fah Hwa Village and that they had brought
the required pistols. The 1st accused then accompanied
the 3rd accused to Fah Hwa Village where they discussed
plans to carry out the assassination of Loh Yue Ding.
About 1 p.m. 19.2.40, the 1st accused detained Zung
Kyung Hsiang to go to the Central Hotel and ascertain
if Loh Yue Ding was in his room. Zung Kyung Hsiang
returned at 3 p.m. and reported in the affirmative.

At 4 p.m. same date, the 1st accused handed Tseu
Heong Leong, Siau Tuh Piau and Siau Zang Tseng a mauser
pistol each, whilst he carried an automatic pistol after
which they proceeded on foot to the Central Hotel where
on arrival the 1st accused instructed Zung Kyung Hsiang
to ascertain whether the intended victim, Loh Yue Ding,

收到此情报后，第一被告指示第三被告进行秘密调查，结果证实上述情报属实。第三被告奉第一被告之命前往浏河，带了该组织的另外两名成员和四支手枪到上海。1940年2月19日上午10时，第三被告向第一被告报告，萧长珍、萧杜便（Siau Tuh Piau，原文此处拼写与前文略有不同）和雍金香已抵达上海，正住在后者位于法华村（Fah Hwa Village）的朋友家中，并带来了所需的手枪。随后，第一被告陪同第三被告前往法华村，在那里讨论了刺杀陆雨亭的计划。1940年2月19日下午1时许，第一被告扣留雍金香，让他去中央饭店查明陆雨亭是否在其房间内。雍金香于下午3时返回，并作了肯定答复。

同日下午4时，第一被告交给周香良（Tseu Heong Leong，音译）、萧杜便和萧长珍每人一支毛瑟手枪，他自己则携带一支自动手枪，随后他们步行前往中央饭店。到达后，第一被告指示雍金香查明预定受害人陆雨亭是否

was in his room, whilst the 1st and 3rd accused and
their two other accomplices waited on the ground floor
inside the hotel. On receiving a reply in the affirma-
tive from Aung Kyung Hsiang, he then led the 1st, 3rd
accused and their two other confederates upstairs to the
second floor and pointed out Room 228 as that occupied by
Loh Yue Ming after which Aung Kyung Hsiang left the hotel.
The 3rd accused and Siau Zang Tseng kept watch
outside the room door whilst the 1st accused and Siau

on a chair beside a table near the wall. The 1st
accused fired two shots at him and Siau Tuh Piau
also fired at him. After the shooting, they went
downstairs and on leaving the hotel separated and
returned on foot via different routes to Fah Hwa Village
where the pistols were handed back to Siau Tuh Piau
who together with Siau Zang Tseng and Aung Kyung Hsiang,
returned to Liuhe.
The 1st and 3rd accused then proceeded to their
respective homes.

在其房间内，而第一和第三被告及其另外两名同伙则在酒店一楼内等候。接到雍金香（原文此处拼写为 Aung Kyung Hsiang）的肯定答复后，他随即带领第一、第三被告及其另外两名同伙上楼至二楼，指出228室为陆雨铭（Loh Yue Ming，原文如此，前文为陆雨亭）所住的房间，随后雍金香离开饭店。第三被告和萧长珍在房门外放哨，而第一被告和萧杜便进入房间，发现受害人坐在靠墙桌子旁的一把椅子上。第一被告向他开了两枪，萧杜便也向他开枪。枪击发生后，他们下楼，离开饭店后分散，经不同路线步行返回法华村，在那里将手枪交还给萧杜便，萧杜便随后与萧长珍和雍金香（原文此处拼写为 Aung Kyung Hsiang）一起返回浏河（Liuhe）。

The 1st accused further admits that although he
did not actually participate in the assassination of
Pan Zung Tung, officer in charge of the Shipping
Administration of the Reformed Government, during
May 1939 on Boulevard de Montigny, one named Wong
Yue Ling (王友林), a member of the China Youth Anti-
Japanese and Traitors Elimination Iron Blood Army had
committed this crime on his instructions. The 1st
accused states that about the middle of April 1939
he visited Miss Chang Ching Loo (張勁廬) Commander-
in-chief of the above organisation, then residing at
the Leong Kong (龍宮) Lodging House, Rue Kreutzer, and
was informed by her to the effect that Pan Zung Tung,
mentioned above, had been collecting unusually high
taxes from various boatmen and also obtaining passes
for the Chinese public to enable them to proceed into
Japanese occupied territory and for which he was charging
exorbitant fees for his services and in view of his
activities it would be necessary to assassinate him.
Chang Ching Loo then instructed the 1st accused to
detail Wong Yue Ling to assassinate Pan Zung Tung.
As a result of enquiries regarding the movements
of the intended victim Wong Yue Ling learned that
he usually walked past the Chinese Y.M.C.A.,

第一被告进一步承认，虽然他在1939年5月蒙太尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）并未实际参与刺杀维新政府航运管理局负责人潘承彤（Pan Zung Tung，音译，前文中文名为潘承彤），但一名名为王友林（Wong Yue Ling）的“中国青年抗日除奸铁血团”成员奉其指令实施了这一罪行。第一被告称，1939年4月中旬左右，他拜访了上述组织的总指挥张劲庐小姐（Chang Ching Loo），当时她居住在克鲁泽路（Rue Kreutzer）的龙宫（Leong Kong）寄宿舍，并从她那里得知，上述潘承彤一直向各船民征收异常高额的税款，还通过办理通行证让中国公众进入日占区，并为此收取高昂的服务费，鉴于其活动，有必要将其刺杀。张劲庐随即指示第一被告指派王友林刺杀潘承彤。
通过对预定受害人行踪的调查，王友林得知他通常每天会路过中华基督教青年会（Chinese Y.M.C.A.），

pages.en:
5/10.

Boulevard de Montigny every day, and armed with a
pistol, supplied by Chang Ching Loo, he kept observation
outside the above premises for approximately 20 days,
but Pan Zung Tung failed to put in an appearance. Wong
Yue Ling failed to make any report to the 1st accused,
however, three or four days later he read in a Chinese
newspaper, the Sun Pao (申报) 12.5.39 issue, that Wong
Yue Ling had been apprehended by the French Police for
the murder of Pan Zung Tung whom he stabbed to death
with a dagger outside the Chinese Y.M.C.A., Boulevard
de Montigny.

Apart from the eight political cases outlined
in Diaries 3 & 4 the only other offences committed in
the Settlement in which charges could be preferred
against four of the seven accused are attempted extortion
and extortion both of a semi-political nature, reported
in Diary 4, sheet 8, and are enumerated hereunder for
clarification.

1st, 2nd, 3rd and 5th Accused.
Extortion of $65.00 from the Tsung Tsong (振中)
Weaving & Dyeing Factory, 841 Ferry Road.

During the course of interrogation the 1st, 2nd
3rd and 5th accused further admit that on the 22.12.39
they concerned together extorted the sum of $65.00
from the Tsung Tsong (振中) Weaving and Dyeing Factory,
841 Ferry Road. The 1st accused states that on the 16th
December 1939, he instructed the 2nd accused to write
a letter to the abovenamed factory, requesting financial
assistance to support the China Youth Anti-Japanese and
Traitors Elimination Iron Blood Army engaged in the
assassination of traitors. This letter was sent through
the post office. At about 8 a.m. 18.12.39 the 1st
accused telephoned to the factory asking if they had
received his letter but he received a reply in the
negative. On the 20.12.39 the 2nd accused, on the
instructions of the 1st accused wrote a second letter
to the Tsung Tsong Weaving & Dyeing Factory again

and Traitors Elimination Iron Blood Army.

factory and as a result of negotiations obtained

of the above organisation. Questioned, the 2nd accused
admits his complicity by the fact that he wrote the
letter to the factory in question.

Translation of a letter addressed to "Tsung Thoong"
Leaving and Dyeing Factory, from Special Service
Headquarters of the 3rd Division of the China
Youth Anti-Japanese and Traitors Elimination
Iron & Blood Army.

December 16th. 1939.

On commencement of the current hostilities on
13.8.37 our division, acting on instructions of the
superior Military Authorities, was despatched to Shanghai
to resist enemy's invasion.
We had been fighting against our enemies at
Shipei, Woosung, Lau-san, and Lo-tien etc. for a
period of over three months, and consequently due
to the strategic reasons we were again despatched
to reinforce our comrades at Ta-tsang.
We pledged to defend this line with the last
drop of our blood, and, therefore, we had vigorous
hostiles with our enemies.
Eventually we received orders from the Superior
Military Authorities, instructing us to retreat from
this line.
In the middle of November, we were instructed
to re-organize our division into guerrilla units, and
our duties are to exterminate traitors.
In compliance with the above order we have
completed about 20 cases.
Well knowing that the management of your factory
is patriotic and has no connection with the enemies we
hereby respectfully request you to permit us to make some
important negotiations with you. Don't be afraid.

Captain of the Special Service
Headquarters (Chopped): Wong Tsung Ming.
Commander of the 3rd Division :
(Chopped) : Yang Heng Hyi.
Chopped : Special Service Headquarters
of the China Youth Anti-Japanese and
Traitors Elimination Iron & Blood Army.

1939年12月16日。

在1937年8月13日当前战事爆发之初，我师奉上级
军事当局指令，被派往上海
以抵抗敌人入侵。
我们在闸北、吴淞、宝山、罗店等地与敌人
作战超过三个月，因此出于战略原因，我们再次
被派往太仓增援我们的同志。
我们誓死保卫此防线，流尽最后一滴血，
因此我们与敌人进行了激烈的战斗。
最终，我们收到上级
军事当局的命令，指示我们从
该防线撤退。
11月中旬，我们奉命
将我师重组为游击部队，
我们的职责是铲除汉奸。
遵照上述命令，我们已
完成约20起案件。
深知贵厂管理层具有爱国心，且与敌人
无任何关联，特此恳请允许我们与阁下
进行一些重要商谈。请勿恐惧。

特别服务
总部队长（盖章）：王宗明。
第三师师长：
（盖章）：杨恒义。
盖章：中国青年抗日除奸

Service Section Headquarters of the China
Youth Anti-Japanese & Traitors Elimination
Iron Blood Army

20-12-39.

Sir,

On the 16th inst. we sent you a letter, which,
if not received, should be traced without fail, as it is
of great importance to your factory.

After the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities
on the 13-8-37, we were rushed here to repulse the Japanese
attacks on Chapei, Woosung, Paoshan, Lotien and other
localities. After a severe battle which lasted for more
than three months, we were ordered by our high command to
reinforce the troops fighting at Tazang, and it was at this
place that we valiantly repelled the enemy with great
sacrifices. We eventually withdrew from the area on
instructions received from our high command. Whilst
retreating from Nantao we reorganised ourselves into a
guerilla unit, which has been responsible for more than 20
cases of assassination perpetrated against traitors in the
outskirts of Shanghai.

As we have lost contact with the Chungking authorities
which accounts for our lack of funds, it is earnestly requested
that you, being true patriots and not a dealer in enemy goods,
will subsidise our military supplies to the best of your
ability so that our work will be more active than ever.

Commander of 3rd Division (Chopped: Yang Heng Yee)
Chief of Special Service (Chopped: Wong Tsung Ming)
Section.

SPECIAL SERVICE SECTION HDQRS. (Chopped).

1939年12月20日。

先生，

本月16日我方曾致函阁下，若未收到，
务必追查，因该信对贵厂
至关重要。

1937年8月13日中日战事爆发后，我们紧急赶赴此地，
击退日军对闸北、吴淞、宝山、罗店及其他
地区的进攻。经过持续三个多月的激战，
我们奉最高指挥部命令，
增援在太仓作战的部队，并在此地
以巨大牺牲英勇击退敌人。最终，我们根据
最高指挥部的指示撤出该地区。在从南市撤退时，
我们重组为游击队，该部队已在上海郊区
实施了20多起针对汉奸的暗杀行动。

由于我们与重庆当局失去联系，导致资金匮乏，
恳请身为真正爱国者且不经营敌货的阁下，
尽力资助我们的军需物资，以便我们的工作
能比以往更加活跃。

第三师师长（盖章：杨恒义）
特别服务处处长（盖章：王宗明）。

During February 1939, I was residing in an upstairs
rear room of a house, number forgotten, Tszepang Road. At
about 8 a.m. date forgotten(7.2.39) I awoke and found Sung
Voong Kiang(沈凤简), not arrested and the wife of Soong
Vung Foo, name unknown, sitting in my room. I asked them why
they had paid me such an early visit whereupon, the wife of
Soong Vung Foo replied, that she had arrived at about 5 a.m.
from Fah Hwa Village bringing with her two pistols for the
purpose of assassinating Tseu Chi Daung(周纪堂) chief of the
Joss Paper Tax Bureau of the Reformed Government, the assassina-
tion to be carried out that day. She also explained that at
6 a.m. Sung Voong Kiang, Soong Vung Foo(宋文富)(not arrested)
and Dau Mau Deu(陶毛头)(not arrested), also arrived at my
home. She further stated that she had handed the pistols to
Sung Voong Kiang who in turn handed one each to Soong Vung
Foo and Dau Mau Deu. At about 7 a.m., same date,(7.2.39)
Soong Vung Foo armed with an automatic pistol and Dau Mau Deu
armed with a Mauser pistol, on the instructions of Sung Voong
Kiang, had gone out to assassinate Tseu Chi Daung.

At about 9.30 a.m. (7.2.39) Soong Vung Foo and Dau
Mau Deu returned to my home when they reported that they had
assassinated Tseu Chi Daung whilst he was riding in a private
ricksha along Singa Road near Midhurst Road. Dau Mau Deu
stated that he went up behind the ricksha and fired one shot at
the back of the victim's head which took effect causing him to
collapse in the ricksha. Immediately after Soong Vung Foo also
fired a shot at his stomach.

王宗明（Wong Tsung Ming），别名单有凤（Zee Yue Fong）。
x D... Craig
C.B.H.G.C.l. 1940年4月23日。

1939年2月期间，我居住在梓芳路（音译）一处房屋的后楼上房间，门牌号已忘。大约在上午8点，日期已忘（1939年2月7日），我醒来发现沈凤简（Sung Voong Kiang，未被捕）和宋文富（Soong Vung Foo，未被捕）之妻（姓名不详）坐在我房间里。我问他们为何如此早来访，宋文富之妻回答说，她于凌晨5点左右从法华村带来两支手枪，目的是暗杀维新政府纸税局局长周纪堂（Tseu Chi Daung），暗杀行动定于当天执行。她还解释说，早上6点，沈凤简、宋文富（宋文富）（未被捕）和陶毛头（Dau Mau Deu）（未被捕）也到达我家。她进一步说明，她将手枪交给了沈凤简，沈凤简随即分发给宋文富和陶毛头各一支。同一天（1939年2月7日）上午7点左右，宋文富手持自动手枪，陶毛头手持毛瑟手枪，按照沈凤简的指示，外出暗杀周纪堂。

上午9点30分左右（1939年2月7日），宋文富和陶毛头回到我家，报告说他们在辛家路（音译）靠近米德赫斯特路（音译）附近，趁周纪堂乘坐私人黄包车时将其暗杀。陶毛头称，他走到黄包车后面，向受害者后脑开了一枪，击中要害，导致其倒在黄包车内。紧接着，宋文富也向其腹部开了一枪。

arrested), Dau Mau Deu(陶毛頭) and I received instructions
from one named Chang Ching Loo(張劫盧)(not arrested) to
assassinate Li Kwoh Jih(李國拉), in charge of the Ministry
of Communications of the Reformed Gov't, about 10 days prior to
the proposed assassination, Chang Ching Loo was in receipt of
information that the intended victim walked along Sinza Road,
near Gordon Road, between 3 and 4 p.m. everyday. Soong Vung
Foo was first led by Sung Voong Kiang(沈风岗) to Sinza Road to
view the identity of the victim. After 5 or 6 days had elapsed,
Sung Voong Kiang came to my home on Tasoneng Road and told me
to be present at a certain room (No. forgotten) in Sinza Lodging
House at 2 p.m. that day (21.2.39) preparatory to carrying out
the assassination. On arrival there at the appointed time I
saw Sung Voong Kiang, Soong Vung Foo and Dau Mau Deu were all
present. Sung Voong Kiang issued Dau Mau Deu and myself an
auto. pistol each, whilst Soong Vung Foo was given a Mauser
pistol. Soong Vung Foo, Dau Mau Deu and I then proceeded to
the entrance of Sou Lai Tsung alleyway, Sinza Road, near Gordon
Road, where we waited until about 4 p.m. when two or three per-
sons were seen coming out of the alleyway and turn east along
Sinza Road. Soong Vung Foo pointed one of them to us as the
victim Li Kwoh Jih. We followed them and I fired a shot at the
back of the victim's head, whereupon he collapsed on the ground
and I fired two more shots at him. I don't know where the
person accompanying the victim went during and after the shooting
Dau Mau Deu, Soong Vung Foo and I made good our escape and walk-
ing east along Sinza Road, returned to the Sinza Lodging House

Tuh Piau, Siau Zang Tseng and Zung Kyung Hsiang to be taken
back to Liuho, Tseu Hoong Loong and I returned to our respective
homes.

本人名叫周恒隆，47岁，高邮人，无业，居住在勃伦南路（Brenan Road）某棚屋内。

1940年2月，我从一名下属处获得情报，该下属名叫Zung Kying Shan，据称汪精卫麾下“国民和平救国军”第七团团长陆雨亭（Loh Yue Ding）经常包租中央饭店（Central Hotel）的一个房间作为联络点，因此我打算除掉这个汉奸。随后我将此事报告给单有风（Zee Yue Fong）（第一被告），他收到此情报后，让我进一步查探陆的行动。大约十天后，陈金香（Zung Kyung Hsiang）再次向我报告，称陆雨亭长期包租了中央饭店二楼的某个房间。于是我带他去见单有风，并向单报告了上述情况，单指示我去浏河找几个人并弄几把手枪。我让Zung前往浏河执行这些指令。后来Zung从浏河找来两个人，分别是萧德标（Siau Tuh Piau）（未被捕）和萧长珍（Siau Yang Tseng）（未被捕），以及三支毛瑟手枪和一支自动手枪，他们抵达上海后，我在法华村西面陈金香的一位朋友家中与他们见面。

1940年4月19日上午，我去见单有风，告诉他人员和手枪已从浏河到达。随后我陪他前往上述地点，他在那里与其他人会合。同日下午（原文误作19.2.40，应为19.4.40）约1点钟，陈金香奉命去打听陆雨亭是否在房间内，他在下午约3点钟回来时，

Zung reported that Loh was in the room of the hotel.

At about 4 p.m. 19.2.40, Siau Tuh Piau, Siau Zang Tseng
and I each armed with Mauser pistol whilst Zee Yue Fong with an
automatic pistol, led by Zung, proceeded to the Central Hotel
where on arrival Zee Yue Fong ordered Zung to proceed upstairs
and first ascertain if Loh was in his room. He returned and
reported in the affirmative and we followed him upstairs to
the 2nd floor where he pointed out Loh's room and left us.
Zee Yue Fong and Siau Tuh Piau entered the room and fired
several shots at Loh whilst I and Siau Zang Tseng stood outside
the room door on watch.

The assassination being completed we went downstairs
and made our escape, separating and returning to west Jah Wah
Village where the pistols were handed to Siau Tuh Piau and Siau
Zung Tseng who eventually took same back to Liuho. I then
returned to my home.

陈报告说陆在酒店房间里。

1940年2月19日（原文日期有误，结合上下文应为4月19日）下午约4点钟，萧德标、萧长珍和我各持一支毛瑟手枪，单有风持一支自动手枪，由陈带路，前往中央饭店。到达后，单有风命令陈先上楼确认陆是否在其房间内。陈回来报告说是，我们便随他上到二楼，他指出了陆的房间后离开。单有风和萧德标进入房间，向陆开了几枪，而我和萧长珍则站在房门外望风。

刺杀完成后，我们下楼逃离，分散行动，回到法华村西面，将手枪交给萧德标和萧长珍（原文此处名字拼写略有不同），最终由他们将手枪带回浏河。随后我返回家中。

T. Tseung

During July 1939 after Miss Chang Ching Loo (張勁廬),
Commander-in-chief of the China Youth Anti-Japanese and
Traitors Extermination Iron Blood Army, surrendered and went
over to Wang Jing Wei's clique, I succeeded her work by
organising a group of 14 members for the extermination of
traitors. Failing to receive the wages for the men from our
superiors, sometimes pawned my own clothing in order to
obtain money to pay the various members for their
maintenance. After having disposed of all my clothing,
I commenced to solicit monetary aid from various factories.

During December 1939 I instructed Lieu Tuh Yoong
(刘德銘) (2nd accused) to write two successive letters to
Tsung Tsoong (振中) Dyeing & Weaving Factory, No. 841
Ferry Road, requesting them for their financial aid,
as a result of negotiations on several occasions I obtained
a sum of $65.00.

During March 1940 acting on my instructions, Lieu
Tuh Yoong wrote a letter to Yoong Foong (永丰) Dyeing &
Weaving Factory, No. 421 Singapore Road, who, after
negotiating with me personally, paid over a sum of $100.00.

All the money thus obtained had been duly paid out
to my subordinates.

On the 29-3-40 Lieu Tuh Yoong was again told to
write a letter to Tau Sing (肇新) Cotton Mill, No. 430 Hapei
Road, which firm, in spite of our negotiations on two
occasions, failed to comply with the request made by us.
However, when I visited this factory for a third discussion

1939年7月，在中国青年抗日铁血锄奸团总指挥张劲庐小姐投降并投靠汪精卫集团后，我接手了她的工作，组织了一个由14名成员组成的锄奸小组。由于未能从上级那里领到成员的薪水，我有时不得不典当自己的衣物，以筹钱支付各成员的生活费。在当掉所有衣物后，我开始向各家工厂寻求金钱援助。

1939年12月期间，我指示刘德铭（Lieu Tuh Yoong）（第二被告）连续写两封信给位于渡船路841号的振中（Tsung Tsoong）印染厂，请求他们提供财政援助，经过几次谈判，我获得了65.00元。

1940年3月期间，刘德铭遵照我的指示，写信给位于新加坡路421号的永丰（Yoong Foong）印染厂，该厂在与我亲自谈判后，支付了100.00元。

所有由此获得的钱款均已如数发放给我的下属。

I was the chief of the 3rd section of the China
Youth Anti-Japanese Traitor Elimination Iron & Blood
Army, and there were 10 members attached to my section,
each being paid $50.00 per mensem.
The pay was issued by Captain Lee Yue Fong,
1st accused, who received same from his superior officers.
On occasions owing to failure of issue of pay
from the superior officers, Lee Yue Fong, 1st accused,
pawned his clothing in order to obtain money with which
he paid to his subordinates.
He having pawned all his clothing, Lee Yue Fong
finally wrote letters asking for monetary assistance from
various local factories.
One day (?) in December 1939 Lee Yue Fong instructed
Lieu Tuh Yoong (刘德), 2nd accused, to write a letter
to the "Tsung Tsoong" (振中) Weaving & Dyeing Factory, No.
841 Ferry Road, asking this factory to contribute some
money to this army. The subsequent negotiations with
this factory were made by Lee Yue Fong himself, and as
a result, he received $65.00, which sum of money he issued
to his subordinates as monthly pay, and I received $15.00.
The above is my true statement.

Signed : Tsoo Heng Lung.

我曾担任中国青年抗日锄奸铁血团第三科科长，我科下有10名成员，每人月薪50.00元。
薪水由第一被告李岳峰队长发放，他从其上级官员处领取薪饷。
有时由于上级未能发放薪饷，第一被告李岳峰便典当自己的衣物以筹钱支付给下属。
在当掉所有衣物后，李岳峰最终写信向当地各家工厂请求金钱援助。
1939年12月的某一天（？），李岳峰指示第二被告刘德（Lieu Tuh Yoong，原文漏字，应为刘德铭）写信给位于渡船路841号的“振中”（Tsung Tsoong）纺织印染厂，要求该厂为本军捐助一些资金。随后与该厂的谈判由李岳峰亲自进行，结果他收到了65.00元，他将这笔钱作为月薪发给下属，我分得15.00元。
以上是我的真实陈述。

Yoong Hwa Zung (榮華臣)

My name is Yoong Hwa Zung (榮華臣), age 35, native
of Musieh, married, employed and residing at the Tsung Tsoong
(振中) Weaving Factory, 841 Ferry Road.

At 9 a.m. on the 13.12.39, I received a letter from
the Young Men's Corps, and at 8 a.m. on the following day, I
received a telephone message asking me whether I had received
the said letter. I replied that no letter had been received
in answer to which the man said that he would send another
letter by messenger the next day. At about 10 a.m. on the
15.12.39, a porter of the factory handed in a letter to me. I
then asked the porter where was the messenger and he answered
that the man was gone. After reading over the contents I found
that it was a letter of an anti-Japanese nature, reporting
the activities of the corps which owing to the financial
difficulties requested the factory to lend them some money

At about 9 a.m. on the 16.12.39, I again received a
telephone message asking me whether I had received the letter.
I asked him to come to my factory to negotiate. The next day
17.12.39, one named Wong (王) came to the factory and
requested me to his organisation a sum of $400.00 per month, b
but I only promised to pay him a sum of $65.00 per month. He
agreed and paid over that sum to him.

This is my true statement.

Signed: Yoong Hwa Zung.

穆谢（Musieh，音译）                                          x D.S. Craig, C.D.S. 47, C.D.C. 266

本人名叫荣华臣，35岁，穆谢人，已婚，受雇并居住在渡船路841号振中（Tsung Tsoong）纺织厂。

1939年12月13日上午9时，我收到一封来自青年团的信，次日（14日）上午8时，我接到一个电话，问我是否收到了那封信。我回答说没有收到信，对方说第二天会派信使再送一封信来。1939年12月15日上午10时许，工厂的一名茶房将一封信交给我。我问茶房信使在哪里，他回答说那人已经走了。我读完信的内容，发现是一封具有抗日性质的信，通报了该团的活动，并因经济困难请求工厂借给他们一些钱。

1939年12月16日上午9时许，我再次接到一个电话，问我是否收到了信。我让他来工厂面谈。第二天12月17日，一个姓王（Wong）的人来到工厂，要求我每月向其组织支付400.00元，但我只答应每月支付他65.00元。他同意了，并将这笔钱交给了他（注：原文逻辑似有误，应为他同意了我的出价，我支付了钱给他，或他代表组织收钱。原文"paid over that sum to him"指工厂方付款给王某）。

以上是我的真实陈述。

签署：荣华臣。

My name is Er Veng Hou, aged 33, native of Wusih,
married, residing at the Zau Sing Cotton Mill, 410 Mapei
Road. I am chief of the Personnel Department of the
above-mentioned mill.

At about 3 p.m. on the 1.4.40, one Lieu Dee Ts
(刘屐之), a coolie employed at the mill handed me a
letter and told me that a messenger was waiting outside
for a receipt. I then issued a receipt for the letter.
I opened the envelop in the presence of one named Yang
Chi Loh (楊啟樂), an Inspector of the mill and learned
it was a report written and chopped by one named Yang Heng
Nyi (楊恒義), Divisional-General of 3rd Division of the
China Youth Anti-Japanese and Traitors Iron Blood Army, and
one named Wong Tsung Ming (王正明), chief of the Special
Service Headquarters regarding their anti-Japanese activities.

At 10 a.m. on the 2.4.40, I received a telephone
message from one representing himself as Yang Heng Nyi,
Divisional-General of the 3rd Division during which I was
asked by him whether I had received a letter or not and
what attitude would I adopt. I immediately replied him on
the telephone that it was strange to me and I had no idea
of it.

At 2 p.m. on the 3.4.40 Chang Ching Yun (张擎宇),
a clerk attached to the Personnel Department, received a
telephone message from one representing himself as Wong Tsun
Ming, chief of the Special Service Headquarters, requesting
a subscription of $3,000.00 in answer to which **〔此处转录不清〕** inform

本人名叫侯文焕，33岁，无锡人，已婚，居住在海伦路410号肇兴棉厂（Zau Sing Cotton Mill，即肇新棉厂，原文拼写略有差异，地址410与前文430略有出入，依原文译）。我是上述棉厂的人事部主任。

1940年4月1日下午3时许，厂里的一名苦力刘屐之（Lieu Dee Ts）递给我一封信，并告诉我有一个信使在外面等候回执。于是我出具了收信回执。我在厂督察杨启乐（Yang Chi Loh）在场的情况下拆开信封，得知这是一份由中国青年抗日铁血团第三师师长杨恒义（Yang Heng Nyi）和特务总部主任王正明（Wong Tsung Ming）署名并盖章的报告，内容关于他们的抗日活动。

1940年4月2日上午10时，我接到一个自称是第三师师长杨恒义的人打来的电话，期间他问我是否收到了信，以及我会采取什么态度。我立即在电话中回复他，这对我来说很奇怪，我对此一无所知。

1940年4月3日下午2时，人事部职员张擎宇（Chang Ching Yun）接到一个自称是特务总部主任王正明（Wong Tsun Ming）的人打来的电话，要求捐款3,000.00元，对此 **〔此处转录不清〕** 告知

him that our management could not afford such a big

On the 5.4.40 a further telephone message was
again received from Wong Tsung Ming saying that if we did
not pay the $3,000.00 in question he would send an armed
man to our mill. He further stated that he had already
exterminated one traitor named Sze Ching Yuen (施全元)
in Yah Sze Loong.

On the 6.4.40 I was afraid some incident might
occur and therefore made a report to the Pootoo Road
Police Station. We constantly received threatening
remarks from Wong by the telephone, since we reported the
matter to the Police.

At 10 a.m. on the 10.4.40 Wong Tsung Ming
visited our mill, but he was refused to interview any
of our staff. He then left and was told the watchman
that he should return at 2 p.m. same day. He returned
at 2 p.m. and was arrested by detectives.

This is a true statement.

他，虽然我们管理层认为这笔捐款应由棉纺业同业公会筹集，但我们负担不起如此巨额的款项。

1940年4月5日，再次接到王正明的电话，他说如果我们不支付上述3,000.00元，他就会派武装人员来我们工厂。他还声称他已经在亚士龙（Yah Sze Loong，音译，可能指某地名或人名关联地，如杨树浦或其他，此处依音译）除掉了一个名叫施全元（Sze Ching Yuen）的汉奸。

1940年4月6日，我担心会发生事端，因此向普陀路警察局报案。自从我们向警方报案以来，我们不断接到王的电话威胁。

1940年4月10日上午10时，王正明来到我们工厂，但被拒绝会见任何职员。随后他离开，并告诉门卫他应在当天下午2点回来。他于下午2点返回，并被侦探逮捕。

以上陈述属实。

rootoo Rd Stn           15.4.40.                        Clerk Phen Kya ..ze.

My name is Zee Yue Fong (單月方) Alias Wong Teung
Ming (王增明). I am 29 years old, born on Nov. 15, 1911, in
the Zee Kya Tsaung Village, Western suburb of Yiencheng, Kompc
My father was a farmer, named Zee Tse Chuan (單慈泉) and my
mother named Zee Hau Sz (單後氏). My father died when I was
three years old. I have three elder brothers, named Zee Hen
Kan (單恒堪), Zee Heng Tsoong (單恆仲) and Zee Hang Hung
(單恆洪) respectively. I studied under a private tutor about
one year and two months. I accompanied my mother to Shanghai
when I was 14 years old and resided with my second elder broth
er on Chung San Road, Chapel. My second elder brother
introduced me to work at the Far Eastern Lumber Company, Chung
San Road, as a coolie and after one year's service, I was
promoted to foreman. I was employed by the above concern
until I was 22 years old, when I was selected to undergo
military training in the "Chung Tsung Camp", at Hwa Tsau
Village (華曹鎮). Having undergone the training for a period
of three months, I returned home and became unemployed.

On January 16, 1934 through the introduction of one
named Sung Voong Kiang (孫鳳岡), with whom I was formerly
employed as a coolie in the Far Eastern Lumber Co., I joined the
"Chung Nyi Labour Union", and later I was nominated by the
members of the union to be a representative of the labourers.
In 1936, I married to a female named Zee Wong Sz (單王氏). On
the outbreaking of the Sino-Japanese hostilities, the above
named union was abolished. I removed my home to a house in the
Tai Ping Li, off Jessfield Road, where I resided with my mother
pages.zh:
第一被告：Zee Yue Fong，别名 Wong Teung Ming
籍贯：江苏盐城。                                    C.D.S. 47 及 C.D.C. 266。
罗脱路巡捕房           1940年4月15日。                        书记员 Phen Kya ..ze。

我叫 Zee Yue Fong（單月方），别名 Wong Teung Ming（王增明）。我今年29岁，1911年11月15日出生于江苏盐城西郊的 Zee Kya Tsaung 村。我的父亲是农民，名叫 Zee Tse Chuan（單慈泉），母亲名叫 Zee Hau Sz（單後氏）。我三岁时父亲去世。我有三个哥哥，分别名叫 Zee Hen Kan（單恒堪）、Zee Heng Tsoong（單恆仲）和 Zee Hang Hung（單恆洪）。我曾跟随私塾先生读书约一年两个月。我14岁时随母亲来到上海，与住在闸北中山路的二哥同住。二哥介绍我到中山路的远东木材公司做苦力，服务一年后，我被提升为工头。我在上述公司工作直到22岁，当时被选中到华曹镇的“忠宗营”接受军事训练。经过三个月的训练后，我回到家乡并失业。

1934年1月16日，通过以前同在远东木材公司做苦力的同事 Sung Voong Kiang（孫鳳岡）的介绍，我加入了“忠义劳工联合会”，后来被工会成员推选为工人代表。1936年，我与一名名叫 Zee Wong Sz（單王氏）的女子结婚。中日战事爆发后，上述工会被解散。我将家搬至兆丰公园路（Jessfield Road）附近的太平里的一处房屋，与母亲

pages.en:
Sheet 2.
and wife. In January, Sung Voong Kiang introduced me and
I joined the " Traitors Elimination Army" of which one named
Lee Tsao Sung ( ) was the leader. He was Sung Voong
Kiang's teacher. In 1939, I removed my home to No. 489 Rue
Lafayette, French Concession.

In January, 1938, by orders of the Chinese National
Government, one named Lee Tsau Sung organized the so-called
"Traitors Assassination Army" in Shanghai, I was then residing
together with one named Sung Voong Kiang in a house at Brenan
Place, O.O.I. and the latter introduced me to join the corps.
I was attached to the 4th group, which consisted of five
members, namely Sung Voong Kiang, Sih Kwei Sung ( ), Soong
Ving Foo ( ), Neu Mau De ( ) and myself, with Lee
Tsao Sung as the group commander. I received $25.00 per month
as my wages. We usually met together at Kuo Tai Lodging
House, Rue Palikao, or the Dah Hoo Hotel, Avenue Edward VII.
F.C.

Murder of Salt
Gabelle Officers
Lieu Kyi Hung &
Lieu Hung Foh.
In June, 1938, we received the first order from Commander
Lee Tsao Sung, who instructed us to assassinate three Chinese
officers attached to the Salt Gabelle, namely Lieu Kyi An
( ), Superintendant of the Gabelle, Lieu Ong Foh ( )
Head of the 1st department, and one other name unknown, Head
of the 3rd department.

About one month ago prior to the assassination, Sung
Voong Kiang led Sih Kwei Sung and me to Sinsa Road near Ferry
Road, where outside the entrance to the Salt Gabelle, he
pointed out the three intended victims to us, as Sih Kwei Sung
pages.zh:
第2页。
和妻子同住。同年1月，Sung Voong Kiang 介绍我加入“锄奸团”，该团首领名叫 Lee Tsao Sung（ ）。他是 Sung Voong Kiang 的老师。1939年，我将家搬至法租界辣斐德路489号。

1938年1月，奉中国政府命令，一名叫 Lee Tsau Sung 的人在上海组织了所谓的“锄奸团”。当时我与一名叫 Sung Voong Kiang 的人住在欧战纪念碑（O.O.I.）附近的布伦南弄（Brenan Place），后者介绍我加入该组织。我被编入第四组，该组由五名成员组成，即 Sung Voong Kiang、Sih Kwei Sung（ ）、Soong Ving Foo（ ）、Neu Mau De（ ）和我本人，组长为 Lee Tsao Sung。我每月领取薪金25.00元。我们通常在法租界白利南路（Rue Palikao）的国泰旅社或爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的大沪旅馆聚会。

盐务稽核所
官员
Lieu Kyi Hung 与
Lieu Hung Foh 被杀案。
1938年6月，我们收到组长 Lee Tsao Sung 的第一道命令，指示我们刺杀三名隶属于盐务稽核所的中国官员，即稽核所主管 Lieu Kyi An（ ）、第一科科长 Lieu Ong Foh（ ）以及另一名姓名不详的第三科科长。

在刺杀行动前约一个月，Sung Voong Kiang 带领 Sih Kwei Sung 和我前往渡船路附近的新闸路，在盐务稽核所大门外，他向我们指认了三名预定受害者，因为 Sih Kwei Sung

pages.en:
Sheet 3.

and I were specially selected to assassinate them. We were also
informed by Lee Tsao Sung that these three officers usually
visited the "Pao Kyien Association" (Health Protection
Association) on Bubbling Well Road west of Chengtu Road.
Enquiries were made by us and the above information was
confirmed. Having ascertained the particulars of the victim's
movements, we then decided to carry out the work on a certain
day in August. On that day, Lee Tsau Sung met us at the Kuo
Tai lodging house, Rue Palikao, F.C. where he gave each of us
a mauser pistol. At about 12 noon Sih Kwei Sung and I left
the above lodging house and proceeded to the vicinity of the
Pao Kyien Association, Bubbling Well Road, where we waited
outside the entrance. I was then wearing a black silk long
gown and Sih Kwei Sung also wore a long gown. We concealed
our weapons under our garments. At about 3 p.m. the three
salt Gabelle officers walked out of the institution and
proceeded east along Bubbling Well Road and entered a motor
car ranked on the south side of Bubbling Well Road, a short
distance west of Chengtu Road, two sitting on the rear seat
and one on the front seat. Before the chauffeur could start
the machine, I inserted my mauser pistol into the side window
of the car and opened fire. I fired three shots. When Sih
Kwei Sung fired, the bullet was jammed in the breech of the
mauser pistol. Having successfully carried out the assassina-
tion, we made our escape by running west along Bubbling Well
Road and turning South into Love Lane, where we took shelter
in a school. I discarded my long gown and weapon in the schoo
pages.zh:
第3页。

和我被特别选中执行此次刺杀任务。Lee Tsao Sung 还告知我们，这三名官员通常前往成都路以西静安寺路上的“保健协会”（Health Protection Association）。我们进行了查询，证实了上述信息。在查清受害者的行动细节后，我们决定在八月的某一天实施行动。当天，Lee Tsau Sung 在法租界白利南路的国泰旅社与我们会面，并给我们每人发了一支毛瑟手枪。中午12点左右，Sih Kwei Sung 和我离开上述旅社，前往静安寺路保健协会附近，在门口外等候。当时我身穿黑色丝绸长衫，Sih Kwei Sung 也穿着长衫。我们将武器藏在衣服下面。下午3点左右，三名盐务稽核所官员走出该机构，沿静安寺路向东行走，并进入停在静安寺路南侧、成都路以西不远处的一辆汽车，两人坐在后座，一人坐在前座。在司机发动汽车之前，我将毛瑟手枪伸进车窗侧面并开火。我开了三枪。当 Sih Kwei Sung 开枪时，子弹卡在了毛瑟手枪的枪膛里。成功完成刺杀后，我们沿静安寺路向西逃跑，然后向南转入爱文义路（Love Lane），在一所学校内躲避。我在学校的

pages.en:
Sheet 4.

classroom and Sih Kwei Sung did the same. We did this because
we were ordered to do so by our superiors as the subsequent
discovery of these weapons, which bore the characters of the
"C.C.F. .B. Nantao" would prove that they had been used to
kill traitors. We then left the school by the front door and
returned to the Kuo Tai Lodging House and reported to Sung
Voong Kiang. About two weeks later, I received a monetary
reward of $100.00. from Sung Voong Kiang.

In September 1938, a joint proclamation was made by
the S.M. Council and the Municipalite Francaise to the effect
that the peace and order of the Settlement and Concession shou
ld be strictly maintained and those who were active in Politic
and harmful to the said Settlement and Concession would be
severely dealt with. Therefore, in fear of his activities
being detected by the above authorities, Lee Tsau Sung retired
and left Shanghai. A female Chinese named Chang Ching Loo
(張靜廬) took his place. This female is stated to be well
known in the Political circles and acquainted with Miss Soong
Mei Ling (宋美齡), the wife of Generalissimo Chiang Kai-
Shek. It is also stated that acting on the instructions of
Miss Soong Mei Ling, Chang Ching Loo organized the so-called
"Chinese Youth Anti-Japanese and Traitors Elimination Iron
Blood Army", with herself as the Commander-in-chief. Sung Voong
Kiang, Sih Kwei Sung and Dau Mau Deu were appointed to be
captains of Special Service Squads. I joined the Army through
the introduction of one named Zee Voong Ming (徐鳳明) who is
a friend of Sung Voong Kiang, but not a member of the corps.
pages.zh:
第4页。

教室里丢弃了我的长衫和武器，Sih Kwei Sung 也照此办理。我们这样做是因为上级命令我们这么做，因为随后发现这些武器上刻有“C.C.F. .B. Nantao”（中央党部调查统计局南市）字样，这将证明它们曾被用于杀害汉奸。随后我们从学校正门离开，返回国泰旅社并向 Sung Voong Kiang 汇报。大约两周后，我从 Sung Voong Kiang 处收到100.00元的奖金。

1938年9月，上海公共租界工部局和公董局联合发布公告，称应严格维持租界和法租界的治安秩序，凡从事政治活动且对上述租界和法租界有害者将受到严厉处置。因此，由于担心其活动被上述当局察觉，Lee Tsau Sung 退隐并离开上海。一名叫张静庐（Chang Ching Loo）的中国女子接替了他的位置。据说该女子在政界颇有名气，并与蒋介石将军的夫人宋美龄女士相识。据称，张静庐奉宋美龄女士之命，组织了所谓的“中国青年抗日锄奸铁血军”，自任总指挥。Sung Voong Kiang、Sih Kwei Sung 和 Dau Mau Deu 被任命为特别服务队队长。我通过 Sung Voong Kiang 的朋友 Zee Voong Ming（徐鳳明）的介绍加入该军，但他并非该组织成员。

pages.en:
sheet 5.

The Chinese National Government supported the army with funds,
which, however, were insufficient, therefore we had to raise
funds when needed. All of the members received a flat rate
of wages at $30.00 per month. I was a sub-officer of my group

Attempted
Murder of
Zau Shih Chuen

In October, 1938, Chang Ching Loo gave orders that
one named Zau Shih Chuen ( 邹志泉 ), Superintendent of the
Consolidated Tax Bureau in Shanghai, be assassinated as he
was denounced to be a traitor. He appointed Sih Kwei Sung,
Soong Vung Foo and myself to carry out the assassination. At
10 a.m. on a certain date in October 1938, Sung Voong King
visited my home at Tseang Road near Shanhaikwan Road, when he
gave me two pistols with four magazines containing 24 rounds
of ammunition and one mauser with two magazines containing 20
rounds of ammunition. Shortly afterwards, Sih Kwei Sung and
Soong Vung Foo also came to my home as per previously arranged

I gave Soong Vung Foo the mauser and two magazines
of ammunition, Sih Kwei Sung a pistol and two magazines of
ammunition while I kept the remaining pistol and 2 magazines
of ammunition. At about 1 p.m. on that day, we three proceeded
to Nanking Road near Honan Road to await the arrival of our
intended victim, I was then wearing a suit of dark blue serge
Chung San uniform and concealed my pistol under my jacket.
Sih Kwei Sung and I took a position on the south side of
Nanking Road outside a silk and piece goods shop, while Soong
Vung Foo stood on the north side of Nanking Road. At about 5
p.m. we saw Zau Shih Chuen's motor car coming from west along
Nanking Road, closely behind was another motor car, in which
pages.zh:
第5页。

中国政府为该军提供资金，但数额不足，因此我们需要在必要时自行筹款。所有成员均领取每月30.00元的固定工资。我是所在小组的下级军官。

企图谋杀
Zau Shih Chuen 案

1938年10月，张静庐下令刺杀上海统税局局长 Zau Shih Chuen（邹志泉），因其被指控为汉奸。她指派 Sih Kwei Sung、Soong Vung Foo 和我执行刺杀任务。1938年10月的某一天上午10点，Sung Voong King 来到我位于山海关路附近的张家宅（Tseang Road）的住所，给了我两支手枪及四个弹匣（共24发子弹）和一支毛瑟手枪及两个弹匣（共20发子弹）。不久之后，Sih Kwei Sung 和 Soong Vung Foo 也按事先约定来到我家。

我将毛瑟手枪和两个弹匣交给 Soong Vung Foo，将一支手枪和两个弹匣交给 Sih Kwei Sung，我自己保留剩下的一支手枪和两个弹匣。当天下午1点左右，我们三人前往河南路附近的南京路等候预定受害者的到来。当时我身穿一套深蓝色哔叽中山装，将手枪藏在上衣下。Sih Kwei Sung 和我占据南京路南侧一家丝绸布店外的位置，而 Soong Vung Foo 站在南京路北侧。下午5点左右，我们看到 Zau Shih Chuen 的汽车沿南京路从西面驶来，紧随其后的是另一辆汽车，车内

pages.en:
Sheet 6.

there were Zau Sih Chuen's body-guards. He ran forward a
few yards and opened fire. Zau Sih Chuen's car was immediate-
ly swerved and turned south into Honan Road and then driven
at full speed. I fired two shots, after which I proceeded to
Kuo Tai lodging house, Rue Palikao, F.C. where I met Sung
Voong Kiang and handed my pistol back to him. Shortly after-
wards Sih Kwei Sung and Soong Vung Foo arrived. Soong Vung
Foo had discarded his mauser pistol in a silk and piece goods
shop when making his escape through the side door of that shop

Murder of
S.C.J.B.
D.S.I. Kung
Zeu Pao.

At the end of January, 1939, Chang Ching Loo gave a
second order to Sung Voong Kiang that a Detective Sub-Inspec-
tor attached to the S.C.J.B. named Kung Zeu Pao be assassina-
ted and Sung Voong Kiang in turn appointed me, Sih Kwei Sung
Soong Vung Foo, Dau Mau Zeu and three others who were unknown
to me to carry out the work. On the day previous to the
assassination, Chang Ching Loo arranged that she would meet
us in a country house in Tai Ping Li, off Jessfield Road at
6 o'clock the next morning. We, seven persons, arrived at the
above address as instructed. Chang Ching Loo disguised herself
as a beggar woman and concealed 8 mauser pistols under rags
in a basket, thus transporting the weapons amongst us. We then
proceeded to Sing Kong Li, off Connaught Road near Jessfield
Village, C.O.L. where we took positions in the vicinity of
Kung Zeu Pao 's Home. At about 7 a.m. Kung Zeu Pao was seen to
leave the entrance to Sing Kong Li, with two bodyguards
in front of him and two behind. We immediately opened fire.
I fired two shots. After successfully carrying out the
pages.zh:
第6页。

坐着 Zau Sih Chuen 的保镖。他向前跑了几码并开火。Zau Sih Chuen 的汽车立即转向，向南拐入河南路，然后全速驶离。我开了两枪，随后前往法租界白利南路的国泰旅社，在那里见到 Sung Voong Kiang 并将手枪交还给他。不久之后，Sih Kwei Sung 和 Soong Vung Foo 到达。Soong Vung Foo 在通过那家商店的侧门逃跑时，将他的毛瑟手枪丢弃在一家丝绸布店内。

上海公共租界警务处
副督察
Kung Zeu Pao 被杀案。

1939年1月底，张静庐向 Sung Voong Kiang 下达第二道命令，要求刺杀隶属于上海公共租界警务处（S.C.J.B.）的副督察 Kung Zeu Pao，Sung Voong Kiang 随即指派我、Sih Kwei Sung、Soong Vung Foo、Dau Mau Zeu 以及另外三名我不认识的人执行此项任务。在刺杀行动的前一天，张静庐安排她将于次日早上6点在兆丰公园路（Jessfield Road）附近太平里的一所乡间别墅与我们会面。我们七人按指示到达上述地址。张静庐乔装成乞妇，将8支毛瑟手枪藏在篮子里的破布下，以此方式将武器运交给我们。随后我们前往中央捕房辖区（C.O.L.）兆丰村附近康纳路（Connaught Road）的新康里，在 Kung Zeu Pao 住所附近占据位置。早上7点左右，有人看到 Kung Zeu Pao 离开新康里门口，前面有两名保镖，后面有两名保镖。我们立即开火。我开了两枪。成功完成

page 7,
assassination, we returned to the country house in Tai Ping
Li, off Jesserield Road, where we handed our weapons back to
Chang Ching Loo.

In July 1939, due to the facts that there were no
financial support forthcoming from the Chinese National
Government and that the Japanese were making every possible
effort to arrest Chang Ching Loo and Sung Voong Kiang, the
"Chinese Youth Anti-Japanese and Traitors Elimination Army"
disbanded and Chang Ching Loo and Sung Voong Kiang surrendered
themselves to the Wang Ching Wei Party. I also retired and
escaped to the country in Kompo, where I stayed until August
1939. I then returned to Shanghai and joined a newly
established "Chinese Youth Anti-Japanese and Traitors
Elimination Iron Blood Army" which were organized by one named
Yang Hung Yee (楊恒義) who is the commander. I was appointed
to be a group officer. There were 14 members under me, namely
(1) Tsu Hoong Loong (周恆祿) alias Tseu Mo Bi (周麻皮)
47, Kompo. (arrested)
(2) Zung Kyung Hsiang (陳金香), 23, Pooning, Kompo.
(3) Wei Tai Te (泰德), 35, Pooning, Kompo.
(4) Tsung Ying Dou (鄭明道), 41, Kompo.
(5) Hou Jung For (許古富), 40, Kompo.
(6) Siau Zang Tseng (蕭長增), 30, Kompo
(7) Kao Teh Chi (高德志), 34, Kompo.
(8) Lee Zang Lien (李長連), 34, Kompo.
(9) Siau Tih Piau (蕭德標), 30, Kompo.
(10.) Teu Ling Hai (朱林海), 32, Kompo.
(11.) To Nyoh Kwei (杜若桂), 38, Kompo.
(12.) Kwoh Sieu Sai (郭秀山), 24, Kompo.
(13.) Wong Nyoh Noo (王五奴), 30, Suinghwa.
(14). Liei Koong Ying (劉公瑩), 38, Kompo.

Apart from these members, there were a clerk and several
orderlies attached to my group. Each member received $30.00
per month as his wages. But, we still had financial difficu-

第7页，
刺杀后，我们返回兆丰公园路附近太平里的乡间别墅，将武器交还给张静庐。

1939年7月，由于中国政府不再提供财政支持，且日本人正竭尽全力逮捕张静庐和 Sung Voong Kiang，“中国青年抗日锄奸军”解散，张静庐和 Sung Voong Kiang 向汪精卫派系自首。我也退隐并逃往江苏乡下，在那里一直待到1939年8月。随后我回到上海，加入了一个新成立的“中国青年抗日锄奸铁血军”，该组织由指挥官杨恒义（Yang Hung Yee）组建。我被任命为组长。我手下有14名成员，分别是：
(1) Tsu Hoong Loong（周恆祿），别名 Tseu Mo Bi（周麻皮），47岁，江苏。（已逮捕）
(2) Zung Kyung Hsiang（陳金香），23岁，江苏普宁。
(3) Wei Tai Te（泰德），35岁，江苏普宁。
(4) Tsung Ying Dou（鄭明道），41岁，江苏。
(5) Hou Jung For（許古富），40岁，江苏。
(6) Siau Zang Tseng（蕭長增），30岁，江苏。
(7) Kao Teh Chi（高德志），34岁，江苏。
(8) Lee Zang Lien（李長連），34岁，江苏。
(9) Siau Tih Piau（蕭德標），30岁，江苏。
(10.) Teu Ling Hai（朱林海），32岁，江苏。
(11.) To Nyoh Kwei（杜若桂），38岁，江苏。
(12.) Kwoh Sieu Sai（郭秀山），24岁，江苏。

My name is Tsu Hoong Loong, age 47, native of Yiencheng,
Kompo, married, unemployed, residing at a straw hut off Brenan
Road, O.O.L.

I was born in Yiencheng Hsien, Kompo, in the year of
1893. My father Tsu Mau Sung (徐茂松) was a rice dealer, who
died when I was 20 years old. I assisted my father in his rice
business when I was 13 years old. Since my father's death,
I was employed as an assistant in a duck and chickens hong in
Yiencheng.

I came to Shanghai when I was 25 years old and was then
employed as a boatman on Soochow Creek. When I was 44 years
old, I pulled public rickshas. At the outbreak of the Sino-
Japanese hostilities, I joined the National Army and was
enlisted in the 4th Regiment, 52nd Brigade, 88th Division.
After the National Army retreated from Shanghai, I became a
hawker selling vegetables in Zau Ka Doo Village, O.O.L.

In November 1939, I met Zee Yue Fong (the 1st accused)
In Zau Ka Doo Village, O.O.L., when he advised me to join the
Chinese Youth Anti-Japanese & Traitors Elimination Iron Blood
Army, of which he is the commander. I agreed to join the army
and he appointed me to be the head officer of the 3rd group.
I have 13 men under me, who were usually active in Liuho and
Quinsan. We have 7 rifles and 2 mausers. Sometimes we fought
with a small number of Japanese soldiers in Liuho and sometimes
we carried out the work of assassinating Chinese traitors.
Each member of my group received $30.00 per month as wages from
Zee Yue Fong.

我于1893年出生在江苏盐城县。我的父亲徐茂松（Tsu Mau Sung）是一名米商，在我20岁时去世。我13岁时协助父亲经营米业。父亲去世后，我在盐城一家家禽行受雇当助手。

1939年11月，我在越界筑路区的曹家渡村遇到了谢月芳（Zee Yue Fong）（第一被告），他劝我加入他担任司令的“中国青年抗日锄奸铁血军”。我同意加入该军，他任命我为第三组组长。我手下有13人，通常在六合和昆山活动。我们有7支步枪和2支毛瑟枪。有时我们在六合与少量日军交战，有时则执行刺杀汉奸的任务。我小组的每名成员每月从谢月芳那里领取30.00元作为工资。

In March 194), I reported to Lee Yie Fong that one named
S Siau Hai Ta residing at Yan S Loong, was
employed by the Japanese Military authorities as an informer,
and usually supplied information regarding the anti-Japanese
activities to the Japanese. Lee Yie Fong, after making enquiries
of his own decided it necessary to appoint someone to
assassinate S Siau Hai Ta.

On receipt of the above instructions, I proceeded to
summon four men, namely, Tsu Ling Hai
(朱林海), Siau Tuh Hien (萧德贤), Siau Sang Tseng (萧生增)
and Siau Chung Hsien (萧忠贤), who accompanied me to Shanghai,
bringing with them two mausers and two magazines of ammunition.
At first, Tsu Ling Hai concealed the weapons on his person on
the way to Shanghai, arriving at Yang Kya Jau Village, Tsu
Ling Hai bought two baskets of vegetables amongst which conceal-
ed the weapons and ammunition. We then entered the Settlement
via the General Bridge, at about 10 o'clock in the morning.
I waited at the North Lung Hwa Li, off Hart Road, whilst they,
four, proceeded to Yan S Loong to carry out the assassination.
Siau Tuh Hien and Siau Sang Tseng each carried one mauser and
magazine of ammunition. At about 5 p.m., they returned and
reported to me that they had completed the work of shooting
S Siau Hai Ta to death. They described the assassination as
follows:-

S Siau Hai Ta was sitting in a small teashop, when Siau
Tuh Hien and Siau Sang Tseng pulled him out. Tsu Ling Hai
fired two shots at the back of his head.

March 28, 1940.

The Chao Sing Cotton Mill.

Sirs,

We beg to remind you regarding the valuable services
which we rendered during the war with the Japanese. At the
outbreak of the hostilities on August 13, 1937, we were detailed
by the Highest Commission of Military Affairs to defence Shanghai
and we fought bitterly against the Japanese for a period of about
three months, later we were transferred to Nantao to reinforce
the Chinese army there, but owing to the heavy and incessant
bombing by the Japanese, all our defensive works were destroyed
and in order to avoid unnecessary sacrifice we were ordered to
retreat.

In November 1937, the Chinese Army evacuated Nantao and we
were disbanded, but organised into a guerilla unit with the
objective of assassinating Chinese traitors, who were utilized by
the Japanese to suppress our countrymen, especially the law abiding
merchants. For the purpose of saving our people from the hands of
the traitors and the Japanese, we are undertaking the work of
clearing them out of the world.

Having learned that you are patriots, being loyal and
faithful to our government, we therefore request you to render us
financial assistance as we are short of funds to support our members.
We earnestly expect that you will not refuse our request.

Jointly Chopped,

Yang Heng Nyi, Commander of
3rd Division.

Wong Tsung Ming, Captain of the
Special Service Squad.

Headquarters of the Special Service Squads of the
Young Men's Anti-Japanese and Traitors Corps.

译文

1940年3月28日。

Zau Sing 棉纺厂。

诸位先生：

谨此提醒贵方注意我们在对日战争期间所提供的宝贵服务。1937年8月13日战事爆发之初，我们奉军事委员会最高当局指派保卫上海，并与日军激战约三个月，随后我们被调往南市增援那里的中国军队，但由于日军猛烈且不断的轰炸，我们的所有防御工事均被摧毁，为避免不必要的牺牲，我们奉命撤退。

1937年11月，中国军队撤离南市，我们随之解散，但重组为一支游击队，目标是暗杀被日本人利用来镇压我国同胞、特别是守法商人的中国汉奸。为了将人民从汉奸和日本人手中拯救出来，我们正致力于将他们清除出这个世界。

获悉各位是爱国者，忠于并效忠于我国政府，因此恳请给予我们资金援助，因为我们缺乏资金来维持成员生计。殷切期望各位不要拒绝我们的请求。

联合盖章，

第三师师长
杨恒义（Yang Heng Nyi）。

特别行动队队长
黄宗明（Wong Tsung Ming）。

青年抗日锄奸团特别行动队总部。
